title: Shield-Captain Vorsk
html:
Shield-Captain Vorsk is a named Thak Shieldbearer seen at level 56.

Where to find Shield-Captain Vorsk

  • in the wilds around 2059, 867

What it can drop

  • Vorsk's Siege Shield (unique Titanium Shield, bound): 1% of kills (1 in 100), 5% from an elite (1 in 20). 15% of landed melee hits hobble the attacker for 3 seconds. The hobble lasts half as long on players.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
